news.title: Nvidia edges down on a report the DOJ is questioning its $12.9B Hugging Face deal
news.summary: Reuters reported Justice Department officials asked whether buying Hugging Face would let Nvidia control a key distribution point for AI models, part of a broader antitrust probe covering its acquisitions, investments and sales practices (including SchedMD, Groq licensing and Run.ai). The deal is expected to close in the first half of 2027. NVDA closed down 1.17% at $215.38.

news.title: Nvidia will invest $3B in Meta's equity offering and expand their AI partnership
news.summary: Meta plans to expand deployment of Vera Rubin GPUs and Vera CPUs, with Spectrum-X Ethernet and BlueField-4, and the companies will deepen work on Meta's Muse models; AMD said it would invest $1B. Oracle separately expanded its Nvidia supply deal to multi-gigawatt scale with Vera Rubin servers. NVDA closed up 0.90% at $217.94.

news.title: Nvidia rallies on AI demand from SpaceX and Anthropic's IPO filing
news.summary: Chip stocks rallied Monday after Anthropic publicly filed for its Nasdaq IPO and SpaceX disclosed its ~$40B GPU financing. Nvidia rose 2.4% to $216.00, helping it recover part of three straight weekly losses.

news.title: Neocloud stocks fall premarket as Musk says more than 200 face 'guppy-level death'
news.summary: Nebius, CoreWeave and Iren fell more than 4% early Monday premarket before paring losses after Musk said debt markets have shut for companies without revenue outside AI data centers. Nvidia, an investor in several neoclouds, has said neocloud demand is "off the charts" and the gap is working capital.

news.title: a16z data shows Nvidia GPU rental prices rising sharply, even for older chips
news.summary: Per a16z (citing Ornn Data), H200 rental rates are up 160% year to date and B200 up 120%, with H100 +35% and even A100s above January levels. NVDA is down 7.6% in October and was up 0.2% overnight.

news.title: At Nvidia's GTC Berlin: Jensen-mania, a shippable Vera Rubin container and neocloud distress
news.summary: Huang unveiled a product packing seven Vera Rubin racks into a road-shippable container and said capital, not demand, is the constraint for neoclouds ("That's going to get solved"); CoreWeave fell 10% and Nebius 7% Thursday. Huang moved on to Kazakhstan Friday. NVDA closed down 0.6% at $210.96.

news.title: Nvidia falls 4.4% as Huang says capital for neoclouds is scarce
news.summary: Huang told CNBC neocloud demand is "off the charts" but "the demand [for] the capital is much greater than the availability of the capital," comments Wells Fargo traders said reignited credit-market worries; CoreWeave fell 10%. The chip index dropped 6.7%, its worst day since June.

news.title: Nvidia unveils the DSX Pod: seven Vera Rubin racks in a truck-shippable container
news.summary: Announced at GTC Berlin, the pre-cabled, liquid-cooled pod is meant to cut the time for a new AI data center to start serving tokens from six months to 14 days. It ships from partners including Foxconn, HPE, Lenovo and Quanta, with deliveries from early 2027; no price was given. Nvidia closed up 2.54% at $221.97.

news.title: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent order over $35B of Nvidia's export-compliant RTX PRO 5500
news.summary: The three ordered more than 3 million RTX PRO 5500 cards at about $11,400 each, but Nvidia told partners it can't guarantee supply and may fill only 5%–10% of requested volumes; total China orders exceed 6 million. Samples are expected in December, with commercial deliveries in Q1 2027.

news.title: Nvidia rises 2% after hours as Musk says SpaceX is bringing ~200,000 GB300s online a month
news.summary: Nvidia closed down 0.29% at $216.47, then rose to about $221 after hours after Musk said on SpaceX's call that it is tracking to bring roughly 200,000 GB300s online per month for the rest of the year, with 2027 primarily Vera Rubin, including a 440,000-chip training cluster by the end of Q2.

news.title: Nvidia wins AI cloud startup Modal for its Vera CPU, its first non-Intel/AMD processor
news.summary: Modal, valued at $15.75B after a $750M round last week, will run Nvidia's Vera CPU alongside Intel and AMD chips for AI-agent workloads after early tests showed it doubled agent throughput. Nvidia has told investors it expects at least $20B of Vera sales this fiscal year; NVDA closed up 1.4% at $217.09 as chip stocks rebounded.

news.title: Chip stocks rise premarket after last week's AI selloff
news.summary: Nvidia, Broadcom, AMD and Intel rose before Monday's open as Nasdaq 100 futures gained about 1.2%. A Seoul Economic Daily report, not confirmed by the companies, says Nvidia asked Micron, SK Hynix and Samsung to use TSMC's 3nm process for the base die of its next-generation custom HBM.

listContext.method: Conservative growth at a reasonable price (GARP), rerun on the full US-listed market (StockAnalysis / S&P Global screener, Oct 28, 2026 close). A stock qualifies if it has: market cap of $10B or more and at least a year of trading history; TTM revenue growth of 15% or more that analysts expect to continue (consensus revenue growth of 8%+ next fiscal year and 8%+ a year over the next 3 years); a positive forward P/E of 35 or less and a PEG of 1.5 or less where available; a Buy or Strong Buy consensus from 5+ analysts with 15%+ upside to the average target; beta of 2.6 or less; share count up no
